bestBets.overview: KARKADAAN looks ready to debut after a getting few trials under his belt. His most recent trial he worked to the line strongly and showed plenty of maturity. Can make a winning start to his career, DREAM INVADER is an interesting runner on debut. Absolutely bolted in at his only trial and looks to have his fair share of ability. Expect he will have plenty of market support and can certainly be winning this on debut.  HARVEYS TURN has been super consistent and can be in the mix again. MONTE SHELL can be a improver 3rd up.

raceTips.comment: Karkadaan has been well educated by way of trials and looked good winning his most recent heat. The early market support is there to suggest a big showing on debut. Yamashita has the benefit of prior race day experience which could make all the difference and there was plenty to like about the way she hit the line last start. Excels was a beaten odds on favourite last time but comes off a gap between runs with gear changes which can spark improvement. Harvey's Turn resuming on the back of a trial with Aaron Bullock in the saddle next.
